implementation.orchestration: DashboardSnapshotBusiness receives the existing month bounds and reads all eight sources in one RepeatableRead transaction, timeout 30000 ms

implementation.compatibility: Same routes, permissions, JSON contract, query relations/order, legacy period policy, monetary calculations and 200-alert previews
implementation.writes: No production read path writes introduced

unit.coverage: One shared transaction and unchanged period/relations; all eight source failures and transaction failure reject

limitations: PGlite serializes concurrent transactions: fixed local read held the writer until completion. Native PostgreSQL CI must prove the writer commits while the RepeatableRead snapshot is still open.
Eight source queries still materialize full client/pool/invoice/payment/visit sets and external register data; no production-volume certification. Transaction-wide timeout is 30 seconds.
Legacy month filter still plannedDate OR date in server timezone and regular visits only; day includes extra. No financial/history/credit reconciliation.
Remaining locales, WhatsApp import, local AI, VPS/restores and physical pilot remain pending; annual contract work is deferred.
